condition: Line-only marker symbols such as 'cross-thin', 'asterisk', 'hash', 'y-up' and 'line-ew' do not show up in a subplot, probably because they have no fill and are drawn only by the marker outline.
workaround: The thread does not give a fix. Setting a visible marker outline, such as marker=dict(line=dict(width=2, color=...)), is likely to make these line-only symbols show up.
